EXPLANATORY

VISITOR

Any person visiting a country other than his own usual place of
residence for a period not exceeding one year and for any reason
other than following any occupation remunerated from within the
country visited.

TOURIST

A temporary visitor staying for a least one night but not more than
one year in the country visited and whose purpose of visit could be
classified as leisure, business, visiting friends or relatives or
attending conferences and meetings other than the exercise of any
activities remunerated from within the country visited.

EXCURSIONIST

A temporary visitor visiting without an overnight stay in a country
other than his usual place of residence and whose main purpose of
visit other than the exercise of any activities remunerated from
within the country list.
